title: CAFE LA LLAVE ESPRESSO ICE CREAM
hookLine: Global-inspired cafe la llave espresso ice cream with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: A note about the espresso: I like using the fine ground espresso brick and making the coffee in a regular moka pot, but you can certainly also use the Nespresso style capsules if you have that type of espresso maker. FULL DISCLOSURE: I personally prefer the decaf espresso, which the Cafe La Llave brand makes to perfection. The ice cream flavor holds either way. In a medium saucepan, heat the cream, milk, sugar and salt over medium heat; whisking to dissolve the sugar (this should take about 4 to 5 minutes). In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks. Incorporate {m53544_1}, {m53544_2}, {m53544_3}, and {m53544_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure heavy cream first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Gradually pour about 1 cup of the hot milk mixture into the egg yolk bowl, while continually whisking. Do this carefully to temper the eggs. (You’re not cooking them.) Add the tempered egg yolk mix back into the pan while whisking until it just comes to a simmer. Remove the pan from the heat, then add the vanilla extract and espresso. Incorporate {m53544_5}, {m53544_6}, and {m53544_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: you can use any ice cream maker. It doesn’t have to be fancy. Use between 2 and 4 shots of espresso (regular or decaf) depending on how strong you like the coffee flavor in the ice cream. I think about 3 shots is ideal. This recipe will yield about 1 quart of ice cream.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Please sit back and enjoy your espresso ice cream. Also, stay cool. You’re welcome. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
